6M.desc: Blood pressure tracks the force of blood against your artery walls during heartbeats (systolic) and between beats (diastolic). Maintaining healthy levels is essential for cardiovascular longevity.

factors: Sodium Intake
High salt consumption causes water retention, increasing blood volume and arterial pressure.

Chronic stress and poor sleep both elevate cortisol, which raises blood pressure over time.
Physical Activity
Regular aerobic exercise strengthens the heart, allowing it to pump blood with less effort.

about.title: About Blood Pressure
about.text: Blood pressure measures the force of blood pushing against your artery walls as your heart beats and rests. Systolic pressure (the top number) reflects the pressure in your arteries when your heart beats. Diastolic pressure (the bottom number) reflects the pressure when your heart relaxes between beats.

about.title: About Heart Rate Variability
about.text: Heart rate variability (HRV) measures the variation in time intervals between heartbeats. Unlike heart rate, which counts beats per minute, HRV reflects how adaptable your nervous system is. Higher variability typically signals better cardiovascular fitness, stress resilience, and recovery.
